## Requirements (contract § In scope)

1. **Zone inventory** `docs/build/reports/dns/zone_inventory_<date -u>.md` —
   A/AAAA/CNAME/MX/TXT/CAA/DS/NS/SOA for the apex and `www` (and any
   subdomain found), each with the exact query and its `date -u`; the LB IPs
   and the managed certificate's names and expiry read read-only.
2. **Runbook** `docs/build/reports/DNS_CUTOVER_RUNBOOK.md` for OP-09
   (operator-executed): TTLs lowered 48 h ahead; LB hostnames DNS-only (grey
   cloud) so Google's load-balancer authorisation keeps seeing the LB IP; R2
   on a subdomain; DNSSEC — the DS record handled at the registrar before and
   after the switch; mail (MX/SPF) checked; rollback = revert the nameservers
   at the registrar; a pre/post checklist with a verification command per
   step; OP-10 (`contact@` alias) right after.
3. **Hand-off** to P35.67's post-move probe (TLS, certificate renewal status,
   every route, mail; second leg ≈ 11-22) and to P34.5's spend ledger
   (Cloudflare/R2/registrar lines).
4. **Doc test** — the runbook has its required sections (TTL, DNSSEC, grey
   cloud, rollback, mail, certificate renewal).

## Evidence log

Live reads executed 2026-10-02T11:44–11:46Z (each query + its `date -u`
recorded verbatim in the inventory file):

- `surveillancegraph.org A` → `136.81.80.102` TTL 14400 (the LB static IP,
  matching `ops/gcp/domain-mapping.sh`'s design and D-P27.10-1's record).
- `www.surveillancegraph.org A` → `136.81.80.102` TTL 14400.
- apex/www `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `MX`, `CAA` — absent (NOERROR/NODATA or empty
  answers, recorded).
- apex `TXT` → `"v=spf1 -all"` (deny-all SPF; no MX — no mail today).
- apex `DS` → `17039 8 2 3F5E85B0…` TTL 3600 — **the zone is a signed
  delegation** (WHOIS: `DNSSEC: signedDelegation`); `DNSKEY` present (KSK
  257 + ZSK 256, alg 8), `RRSIG` on the apex A (inception
  2026-09-30T21:57:57Z, expiry 2026-10-22T21:57:57Z, key tag 50430). The DS
  at the registrar is THE critical cut-over item.
- apex `NS` → `nsc1–nsc4.squarespacedns.com` TTL 21600; `SOA`
  `nsc1.squarespacedns.com. cloud-dns-hostmaster.google.com. 1 21600 3600
  259200 300`.
- `whois`: Registrar Squarespace Domains LLC; registry expiry
  2027-09-22; DNSSEC signedDelegation; NS as above.
- `dig axfr … @nsc1.squarespacedns.com` — timed out (transfer refused/
  filtered); subdomain enumeration by probing: `api`, `mail`, `contact`,
  `status`, `docs`, `app` → all NXDOMAIN.
- `openssl s_client -connect surveillancegraph.org:443` → cert
  `CN=surveillancegraph.org`, issuer `Google Trust Services WR3`, SAN
  `{surveillancegraph.org, www.surveillancegraph.org}`, notBefore
  2026-09-23T17:54:08Z, **notAfter 2026-12-22T18:47:21Z** (matches G1:82's
  "expires 2026-12-22").
- `curl -sI https://surveillancegraph.org/` → 200;
  `https://www.surveillancegraph.org/` → 301 → apex;
  `http://surveillancegraph.org/` → 301 → https.
